name: Elicit
tagline: AI research assistant for academic papers
description: Elicit is an AI research assistant for finding and analysing academic papers, with a free Basic plan and Pro, Scale and Enterprise plans.
features: Search across more than 138 million papers
Zotero import; API access on Pro
strengths: Free Basic plan with unlimited paper summaries
Enterprise plan states no training on your data by default
limitations: Free usage of the Research Agent and Reports is limited
A separate monthly-billing price is not stated for paid plans

plans.name: Pro

Systematic review screening of up to 5,000 papers
